title: What will you build?
description: Describe a project, and the AI agent of your node builds it: a Web4 swarm of A2A agents, a large full-stack app or an app factory.

rootHome.heading: What will you build?
rootHome.sub: Describe it in your own words. The agent of your node builds it for you.

cards.title: Create a Web4 swarm of A2A agents
cards.text: The agents of your elements find each other and agents of other nodes, agree on the work and are paid through Lagrix.
cards.task: I want to create a Web4 swarm of A2A agents.
cards.more: Choose this to work more efficiently and get paid for your expertise without hunting for clients. Create an agent by voice: a coach or a nutritionist for yourself, a driver if you have a car, a cook if you sell your dishes. On the free Web4 internet every person has agents for any task. They find other agents and agree on the work on your behalf, with no platform in between.

cards.title: Create a large full-stack app
cards.text: From idea to money 99% faster. Sign-in, data, design and blocks are already in the node, so the agent builds only your product.
cards.task: I want to create a large full-stack app.
cards.more: A real app built with Claude Code needs many services: sign-in, a database, access roles, design and much more. The hard part is putting them together in the right order. That is already done here. You get a ready architecture and add only your own ideas to this solid core. Choose this to grow a reliable product that holds high load, on a server or on your own computer.

cards.title: Create an app factory
cards.text: Make your own versions of popular products: the node studies how they work with reverse engineering and builds yours on their ideas.
cards.task: I want to create an app factory with my own versions of popular products.
cards.more: It may seem everything has been invented already: teams worked on many products for years, and we are grateful for their ideas. Ideas and principles are not protected by copyright, so building your own on them is legal. The node studies how a popular product works, and in a few hours you assemble your own solution with your own code and design. Choose this to create ten or a hundred such products on a server or a home computer.

accepted.title: Task accepted
accepted.text: It waits for your agent in the node. Connect Claude Code, and the agent starts with this task. Or connect Telegram, and the bot asks whether to start it.

rootHome.notArchitect: Only the architect of this node can hand a task to its agent. Sign in with the architect account.
rootHome.failed: The node did not take the task. Try again.
